title: THE LAST FRAME
logline: A freelance filmmaker discovers her camera records future events, including a warning from her future self about an impending disaster and a mysterious betrayal, forcing her to make a critical choice to alter her fate.

characters.name: FUTURE MAYA
characters.description: Maya's future self, appears in a video message.

characters.name: DANIEL
characters.description: A producer, aware of the future camera's abilities, communicates with Maya.

vfx_requirements: Camera screen displaying future timestamp and filenames

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Maya works on monitors when her old digital camera mysteriously turns on, showing a future timestamp. She discovers a video file from her future self.

scenes.heading: ON THE LAPTOP SCREEN - VIDEO
scenes.summary: A video plays showing Future Maya in a damaged apartment, warning current Maya about an upcoming event, the 11:47 train, and not to trust Daniel.

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - LATER
scenes.summary: Maya receives a text and call from Daniel, who also saw a future video and urges her to destroy the camera. The apartment lights flicker, and the camera begins recording again.

scenes.heading: INT. TRAIN STATION - NIGHT
scenes.summary: At the train station, Maya's camera records a figure behind her and a train derailing. Daniel, on the arriving train, urges her to get off. She does, and the timeline updates.
